subject: Azure Marketplace private plan: entitlements, certification timeline & invoicing path
messages:
From: Elena Photis <elena.photis@nimblecloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: mpn-support@microsoft.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: private plan entitlements & invoicing path for NimbleCloud

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at NimbleCloud here — we're preparing a private plan listing for internal eval and need to confirm a few things before we complete the PO:

- How entitlements map to SKUs for seat-based vs token-based billing (we have two internal teams with different consumption patterns).
- Timeline and prerequisites for the "Azure certification" (we were told some customers need an Azure co-sell enablement step before marketplace listing).
- Preferred invoice routing options for private plans (we need invoices to go to our AP team in AP@nimbuscorp.com rather than Microsoft).

Attached: a short procurement checklist (PDF). Can you loop in whoever manages the Azure commercial onboarding? Also cc'd Microsoft support to confirm any partner-side certification gating.

Best,
Elena Photis
Head of Procurement, NimbleCloud Inc.
---
Attachment stubs: procurement-checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Photis <elena.photis@nimblecloud.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, mpn-support@microsoft.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: private plan entitlements & invoicing path for NimbleCloud

Elena —

Great to connect. Quick answers up front, then a proposed MAP (mutual action plan):

1) Entitlements/SKUs:
   - We can expose two entitlement families: "Seat" (per-user monthly) and "Consumption" (per-1k tokens). We'll map each NimbleCloud product line to a separate SKU for clearer invoicing. I'll attach a draft SKU mapping.
2) Azure certification / co-sell gating:
   - Marketplace private plan listings require publisher onboarding + a short certification attestation. For co-sell enablement with Microsoft, there's an additional partner manager step (usually 1–3 weeks once the publisher profile is complete).
3) Invoice routing:
   - Private plan invoices can be routed to customer AP by configuring the billing contact on the publisher side and passing invoice metadata via the marketplace payload. We need a signed PO and a billing contact + W-9 (or equivalent).

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Today: confirm desired SKU split + billing contact (Elena)
- Tue (21 Dec): we share redlined SOW and SKU mapping (Logan)
- Wed–Thu: Redwood signs commercial terms; NimbleCloud sends PO + tax forms
- Following week: publisher onboarding with MS; expect co-sell sign-off 7–21 days

I'm attaching a Publisher_Onboarding_Checklist and a draft SOW for redlines. Karthik, can you weigh in on the billing path and any billing-team needs?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Publisher_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx, RDW_Draft_SOW_v3.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Photis <elena.photis@nimblecloud.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: mpn-support@microsoft.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: private plan entitlements & invoicing path for NimbleCloud

Elena / Logan —

Couple of operational notes from the commercial ops side:

- Invoice routing: we can set NimbleCloud as the invoice recipient but Microsoft's marketplace payout still flows through the publisher payment relationship; for private plans we typically add an AP metadata block so your AP system can auto-match. Please confirm the exact AP email and billing remittance address.
- Entitlement IDs: please confirm whether you want separate entitlements per team (recommended) or one umbrella entitlement with internal allocation. Separate IDs make usage reporting and cost attribution far simpler.
- Marketplace publisher info we need from NimbleCloud: MPN ID (if you want co-sell), Publisher name for the listing, and the publisher's company legal name for the invoice header.

I've created a short list of required fields and uploaded it to the HUBSPOT link below — filling those will speed up onboarding.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
---
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/ENG-89123

From: Elena Photis <elena.photis@nimblecloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimblecloud.com, mpn-support@microsoft.com
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: private plan entitlements & invoicing path for NimbleCloud

Thanks — attached are NimbleCloud's redlines to RDW_Draft_SOW_v3. Key items we flagged:

- Section 2.1 (Entitlements): want explicit language that seat SKUs auto-scale only with written approval (our legal requires this).
- Section 4 (PCI/Compliance): request to add an annual audit attestation clause and evidence of data residency controls in Azure regions (we operate in us-west and eu-west).
- Billing: prefer invoices to be issued to NimbleCloud Inc., AP@nimblecloud.com, with Net30 and a PO number on the invoice. Microsoft's standard flow will be fine as long as metadata and invoice PDF include the PO.

We are also asking Microsoft support whether any additional marketplace certification paperwork is required for private plan co-sell enablement.

Elena
---
Attachment stubs: SOW_NimbleCloud_v3_redlines.docx (tracked changes)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Photis <elena.photis@nimblecloud.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: mpn-support@microsoft.com
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: private plan entitlements & invoicing path for NimbleCloud

Elena —

Appreciate the redlines. Quick legal/commercial responses inline below then next steps:

- Section 2.1 (Entitlements): we can add the explicit "written approval" clause to prevent auto-scaling changes without PO approval. We'll add a short change-order process into the SOW.
- Section 4 (PCI/Compliance): Redwood can provide the SOC 2 attestation and a high-level data residency statement for the regions you listed; the annual audit attestation is acceptable but we'll need to redact specific vendor audit artifacts. We'll provide an evidence bundle after signature.
- Billing: we accept Net30 to "AP@nimblecloud.com" provided PO number is included on the invoice. For tax forms, please send a completed W-9 (US) or local equivalent.

On certification timing: once NimbleCloud completes the publisher form and we submit the private plan package, publisher onboarding + certification typically takes 7–21 calendar days. If Microsoft partner manager is willing to expedite, that timeline can compress to ~5 business days. I'll include the Publisher Manager contact in a separate note.

Next steps:
1) Logan: upload final SOW with the "written approval" language and the change-order appendix (today EOD).
2) Elena: send PO + billing remittance details + W-9 (if US) and confirm whether you want separate entitlement IDs for the two teams.
3) Karthik: we need the internal invoice metadata template so NimbleCloud can confirm match fields.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: RDW_Azure_Private_Terms_2026-12-22.pdf (commercial terms summary)

From: Elena Photis <elena.photis@nimblecloud.com>

- NimbleCloud will provide a PO and W-9 to AP@nimblecloud.com by EOD Thursday (23 Dec).
- We want separate entitlement IDs for the Research and Production teams; please include both in the SKU mapping.
- NimbleCloud requests expedited publisher onboarding. Can you please connect us to your Microsoft Publisher Manager so we can request prioritization?

We are good to proceed with the redlined SOW once the small edits are incorporated. Let's do a 30-minute wrap call Thursday morning to confirm final fields and the invoice remittance block.

Best,
Elena Photis
Head of Procurement, NimbleCloud Inc.
